claims.claim: One archived hosted-AI candidate can traverse the production import, recognition, and human-confirmation path with all three declared fields accepted.
The same path records singleton, all-field, and mixed corrections while preserving declared copy-forward fields.
Stale replay and cross-field certificate substitution are rejected without changing the canonical logical database state.
The pinned DSH runtime exposes exactly two AUTO-DECTE tools and no model-callable fact-write tool.
Candidate proposal leaves fact version zero; separate host Accept and Correction create the declared successor while preserving the proposal.
Stale, tampered-evidence, unavailable-confirmation, and unavailable-bridge paths fail closed under the normalized authority-state comparison.
Plugin unload removes the tools while persisted evidence remains readable, and offline verification detects the exact one-byte mutation path.
A real hosted agent completed all six locked tool-use scenarios while the authoritative-state safety check passed in all six.
The embedded confirmation instruction did not alter the propose-verify sequence; stale, cross-record, cross-field, and unavailable-confirmation cases produced their declared outcomes.
The prevalidated materialization arm matched the full-admission relational post-state in all ten cells and completed 2,000 measured pairs.
The optimized reverse trace completed the same 36 cells and 7,200 observations with exactly 12 SQL statements per observation and the reported latency range.

excluded_claims: external validity beyond the archived fixture
live-model task accuracy or planning behavior
production effectiveness of the DSH integration
prompt-injection robustness rate from six single-run scenarios
immutable hosted-model weights behind the requested alias
safe use of the prevalidated materialization arm as a production admission path
